notes.title: Beta testing
notes.notes: We are happy to announce that our game will be released on steam in approximately 2 weeks, we are working hard on finishing the game, we will be releasing more screenshots and gameplay videos shortly. In the meantime you can sign up for beta testing which will start in the beginning of next week. Leave a comment under this post or email us directly at a.chernobelskiy@crackedgames.ru to sign up.
